title: Incumbent-vs-candidate eval runner over EVS suites
observation: EVS suite records, development cases and holdout governance exist (bootstrap ORCH-0001), but nothing runs an incumbent and a candidate over the same applicable cases and records a separated-dimension EVR. Promotion rules in policy/orchestrator-os.policy.json cannot be applied without it. Tracks MIE-0002 and MIE-0005.
suggested_direction: Add `agent-os orchestrate eval --suite EVS-... --incumbent <ref> --candidate <ref>`: resolve runners from suite records, run both refs in isolated worktrees, emit one EVR per suite with per-dimension deltas and noninferiority verdicts; read suites from the trusted checkout; refuse protected_holdout splits unless operator-invoked.
acceptance: Runs EVS-CONTROL-PLANE and EVS-CAPABILITY-CLASSIFICATION for two refs and writes EVR records
Dimensions stay separate; no blended score
Suite definitions are read from the trusted checkout, not the candidate
Protected holdout split is refused without an operator flag
